grid: LOLA LDEM_75S_240M polar stereographic (pixel 240 m, pole at pixel 1905.5). level 0: 2.88 km cells lat<=-84; level 1: 0.96 km cells lat<=-88.5. i=row(line) offset, j=col(sample) offset from pole, in cells.
method: Sun/Earth as point sources (Moon-centred directions from ephem.json) vs 64-azimuth terrain horizon (rays to 150 km, 2 m mast) from LOLA 240 m DEM. slope = mean 240 m slope over cell.
uncertainty: Illumination is extremely local on ridges: a cell value is for its centre point only. Use pins (exact masks) for named sites. ~±10 pts vs 20 m DTM literature. longest_night_h is a lower bound if it touches the window edge.
